label: Lounge
info:
### Lounge Scene Engine — DRAFT (not live)

**Test procedure**
1. Disable the existing **Lounge** tab first (edit tab → Disabled), then enable this one. If both are active every scene button fires two engines.
2. While the Lounge tab is disabled its TV-polling section is offline too (auto light dimming when the Shield starts playing won't run during the test).
3. Test: each scene button, exclusions, status text, green plug auto-scene, midnight eztimer (manual trigger), Xmas (timers are suspended — toggle input_boolean.xmas_switch manually).
4. When adopted: delete the old scene section from the Lounge tab, keep the TV-polling section.

**Deliberate differences from the live flow**
- One 6-entity trigger + data-driven Scene Engine function instead of 18 triggers.
- `input_text.lounge_status` is cleared only by the none-on check (live had 4 racing clear calls). Always cleared on last-scene-off and at midnight.
- `unavailable`/`unknown` switch states are ignored (live ran teardown on them).
- Exclusion state-checks dropped: input_boolean.turn_off on an already-off switch is a no-op.
- `ha-get-entities` none-on list fixed: `input_boolean.whatsapp_switch` (was `.whatsapp`) and ` input_boolean.reading_switch` leading space removed. Xmas excluded (standalone).
- Midnight wires straight to the 5 shared turn-off nodes + lights + fan.
- Dead `link out` nodes kept as REVIEW nodes (links=[] as in live) so the wiring decisions can be made; nothing new is wired to lights.
- The 5 dead `poll-state` nodes are NOT included — re-add if Shield latency returns.

name: TV Bring-up
info:
Parameterised TV/soundbar bring-up (movie & Wii share the logic).

env:
- `tv_source` — LG webOS source name (Streaming Box / WII)
- `sound_mode` — soundbar profile (Standard / Bass Blast)
- `sound_volume` — volume (0.4 / 0.2)

Sets `tv_auto_on` on entry, clears it after source select, so the untouched TV-polling section behaves exactly as with the live flow. First internal node reads env into msg via env.get() (same idiom as the Light On subflow), service data uses {{mustache}}.
